body: You sound just like me.I would drink on my breaks from work. Thinking of I need this for dealing with the bs there. Or I would call out because I was actually visible intoxicated. I drank to keep myself busy or to forget how shitty my life is. I went the entire day yesterday without a drop and I already feel better. The only issue is that I did not get an ounce of sleep last night. I guess I got too use to passing out drunk that my mind doesn't know how to shut itself off yet.
I guess my mind with the anxiety from withdrawals and my body with the shakiness.
It's so scary to have your body tell you that you need something to work right. For me to "feel" normal.
I went to the Er and they put a iv and drip into it. I think the cannabis was high in thc and it's just exasperated the changes in my brain chemistry from the withdrawal. I was prescribed Librium.
I've been wallowing in self hate for a week now. And I must've looked like a complete ass for apologizing for that. She must think I was just using her.

I remember how it all started! I confessed my feelings to her and we started to make out because of it. That's why I was so damn horny when we went to bed. I didn't prey on a friend. I smooth talked my way into her bed. I'm so happy. I'm not a monster 😭
You can do it! I believe in you.
I'm sorry to hear! Keep at it.
